Don't let patterns bind you. Don't be seduced by immediate gain.
Dominating the entire board—that is the true essence of board games.

Haha, I appreciate the kind words. But your pace of improvement is
quite impressive too. You gave me quite a run for my money today.
"Oh...? Quite a shrewd move. You've clearly studied well."

"Good work, can you hear me?
—Alright, shall we get started?"
Listening to the leaking voice—all of a sudden, it sounds strangely familiar.

Such a handful... Ah, perhaps I should have kept a closer eye
on her during her junior academy days so she'd grow up more diligent...

Fixate too much on short-term gains, and your view of the board clouds.
The focusing illusion—a textbook cognitive bias.
Huh? Who're you...?

Holding her head in exasperation is Air Groove—as expected of the
student council vice president, her strict yet caring nature shines through.

Well then, let's go all out on an 8x8 today.
I'm looking forward to seeing how much stronger you've gotten, you know?
Promising to play again over the weekend, we called it a day.

Even after I explicitly ordered her to show up for training today,
she didn't just ditch, she won't even reply to me!

Ruler! Hey, answer me, Ruler!
Can you hear me?! Are you awake?!

That's some blatant slacking...
Holed up for three whole days is something we simply cannot overlook.

Terrifyingly enough, domi-san is knowledgeable in all sorts of games,
from classic board games to the latest titles. As someone who admires them—

Regardless of whether it's an old, unused clubroom,
turning it into her personal hideout is problematic enough, but...
(Ringgggggggg—CLICK!)

If she's just ignoring me or sleeping, that's one thing,
but if she fell ill and collapsed... that would be a disaster.

Oh, interested? I can teach you anytime. Gathering some people
online to play social deduction or area control games could be fun too.

While it's a simple, classic game, the online matches get heated.
And that's because—
Why, that absolute fool...!

"Anytime works for me, I'll match your schedule.
I'm basically always online, so feel free to drop in whenever you feel like it."

She went straight home the moment class ended, you say?!
After I drilled it into her head to come today...! Just how long does she plan to keep slacking off!
Strangely familiar... doesn't begin to cover it. I hear this voice almost every single week...!

"Too noisy." "Busy gaming online right now."
"Holed up till the day after tomorrow."

"Come out of there, you blockhead!" "Why are you even here?! Where'd you get the key?!"
"You're going to run today if it kills me!!" "Whoa, wait, aahhh—"

In a quiet corner where the clubrooms stood, she was banging loudly on the door of an old, small building.
Could that problematic student be barricaded inside...?
Eeeeeeek?!?!
Fair enough... If you're going to sleep right through it, I'll just have to shake you awake myself.

What did she mean by that...? Unable to grasp it right away, I stared at the board.
—And then, it suddenly hit me.

Domi-san was a player I deeply admired. Through a stroke of luck, we became voice-chat sparring partners,
but even now, I couldn't help but look up to their extraordinary skill.

!! Did she just... hang up on me...?! 
—Wait, LANE? .........

Indeed, you were far too obsessed with "taking the corners."
That's why you failed to realize I was systematically narrowing down your options all along.
I was cutting off your retreat.
You'll get used to 10x10 in no time, and maybe you could pick up other board games too, yeah? It sounds fun to play chess or card games with you.
Haha, you think so? Well, it's true that 10x10 Reversi ramps up the tactical difficulty with all those extra squares.
What shall we do today? 8x8 is fine, but... isn't it about time you gave 10x10 a shot?

Wait, hold on, let me go, Air Groove-san!
I really wanted to clear out my game backlog today, come oooon~~!

While you were busy fretting over securing the corners,
what do you think I was doing?
"——Too naive, though."
Right... If it's come to this, I'll have to use force.

Hm. You're... the Trainer. Look at this mess—Ruler...
That lazy blockhead has made this place her stronghold and locked herself inside.

"—Oh, look at the time. Let's call it a day here.
Next time, let's have a proper match on a 10x10 board."
Because it was also where I interacted with "dominare"—or Domi-san—an unmatched, elite veteran in the online gaming community.

With that, what Air Groove pulled out of her pocket was—
the key to the clubroom!! The Student Council Vice President's authority shines once again...!
Get out here already, you blockhead!!

At night, as soon as I returned to my room, I booted up my PC to play some games.
Lately, I've been hooked on the board game Reversi.
A complete defeat. To think I could be overwhelmed so brilliantly...
An angry shout echoed across the training grounds.

One afternoon. Hearing Air Groove's furious shouts, I stopped in my tracks.
...It felt like a strange case of déjà vu.
Corners are everything in Reversi! Pouring everything into putting the "corner-claiming" patterns I'd drilled into my head over the past few days into practice—

Today is the last straw!!
I've been going far too easy on you until now!!
